name: Shodan
tagline: Internet-wide search engine for exposed devices, services, and banners.
description: Shodan is an internet-wide search engine that indexes banners and metadata from exposed devices and services. Its REST API lets developers query hosts, search by filters, look up DNS and ports, stream data, and manage scans—used for attack-surface discovery, asset inventory, and vulnerability research.

auth.details: API key via query parameter `key` (e.g. ?key=YOUR_API_KEY); self-serve at account.shodan.io. Some clients also accept key in headers depending on client library.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan: 0 API query credits (no REST API access). Membership (paid) required for API query credits; higher plans add filters, streaming, and scan credits—see shodan.io/pricing and account plan.
pricing.paid_plans: Membership and enterprise plans with higher query credits, filters, and streaming; see shodan.io/pricing

rate_limits: Plan-dependent; published limits tied to query credits and scan credits—see developer docs and account plan.
use_cases: look up open ports and banners for a specific IP
search the internet for devices matching a service or product filter
resolve hostnames and reverse DNS for exposed assets
check which services are exposed on a target network range
monitor for newly indexed devices matching a query
